about_the_game:
Delivery Impossible is an arcade truck driving simulator spiced with fun and a little bit of madness.

After years of working for the companies, Tom, a skilled and experienced driver, decided to start his own business from scratch. But getting into an established business isn't that easy! To get decent contracts, you have to work tirelessly, fulfilling strange, funny and surprising deliveries.

The demo version of the game includes:
- 3 complete levels (representing different cars and cargo types)
- A varied electronic soundtrack
- World destruction: you can crash and smash anything you like, including your own cargo!

The full version of the game, coming out in fall 2023, will include new vehicles, 20+ exciting missions, and advanced gameplay mechanics.
